# Atlas AI Institute

> Atlas AI Institute is an independent, evidence-led research institute focused on AI policy, governance, and institutional capacity.

## Public sections

- [About](https://atlasai.institute/about-atlas-ai-institute/): Institutional purpose, mission, and approach.
- [Research](https://atlasai.institute/research/): Research portfolio across AI governance, digital sovereignty, institutional capacity, information integrity, and public policy.
- [Frameworks](https://atlasai.institute/frameworks/): Published policy and governance frameworks.
- [Reports](https://atlasai.institute/reports/): Research reports and policy intelligence publications.
- [Publications](https://atlasai.institute/publications/): Publications, frameworks, reports, and related research.
- [Projects](https://atlasai.institute/projects/): Public-interest digital systems and governance projects.
- [Tools](https://atlasai.institute/tools/): Research and governance tools.
- [Leadership](https://atlasai.institute/leadership/): Institutional leadership and advisory network.
- [Nafiul Ahmad Rafi](https://atlasai.institute/leadership/nafiulahmadrafi/): Founding Director profile.
- [Atlas Global South AI Policy Coalition](https://atlasai.institute/atlas-global-south-ai-policy-coalition/): Coalition information and committee profiles.
- [Insights](https://atlasai.institute/insights/): Public insights and analysis.
- [Contact](https://atlasai.institute/contact/): Research and institutional collaboration enquiries.

## Citation and access

Use the linked page as the canonical source for visible content. External publication and PDF links remain hosted by their original repositories. This file is a discovery aid and does not replace robots.txt, access controls, attribution, or the terms of linked services.

## Crawler policy note

Search indexing, user-requested retrieval, and model-training/product-improvement crawlers are separate provider policies. Atlas AI Institute does not treat robots.txt or llms.txt as a security boundary or as a guarantee of indexing, training exclusion, or model behavior.
